beats.headline: She explains how the shows work
beats.text: Okay. So. Carl has just met his first Borant dungeon admin and managed to be civil, which I am counting as a win for everyone, including me. My job today is to walk them through how crawlers take part in the Syndicate programmes, and I get through all of it. Then Princess Donut mentions Gossip Girl, and Mordecai has seen it, and I have seen it, and for a few minutes nobody in the room is anyone's liaison.

beats.headline: Nobody in this room is an idiot
beats.text: Okay, so, Carl shouts at me, and I let him finish. Then I tell him how it actually is. Mordecai relaxed the moment he saw I wasn't wearing a party badge. My boss is a member. If I say the wrong thing, my entire family is wiped from the universe. The mobs out there live in fear of crawlers. We are all parts of the same machine, and all of us are afraid. I am on your side, Carl. The better you do, the longer you survive, the better I do.

beats.headline: A voice in his head
beats.text: Okay, so, I have been watching. Carl tells Brandon that the day we stop helping each other is the day we stop being human, and it is great, and I ask him to say it again without the cough. He will not. The save-the-elderly storyline is playing well with most viewers; about twenty percent of the focus group calls them dead weight. Princess Donut is right that it is a little dry. Then an old man stands up on the train with his pants around his ankles, and I tell them to run.

beats.headline: Censured, and cleared
beats.text: Okay, so, I was censured by the System AI. It decided I cheated by warning Carl and Princess Donut before the rage elemental appeared, and I was suspended. My representative appealed, and on review they found Carl noticed the man at the same moment I shouted, so my record is clean. It is not really clean. Once the AI notices you, it is difficult to get it to un-notice you. Mukta should never have booked that show, and I apologise. Also, Carl, there is a video I need to tell you about.

beats.headline: Thumbs up on the classes
beats.text: Hello, hello. Okay, so, good news, Carl and Princess Donut. Odette's show was another hit, and the majority of viewers are giving a thumbs up to your class and race choices. Both of you picked unique classes, which is always a plus. There are a few other Primals, no straight cats, one were-cat and some cat girls. The public cannot see Mordecai now. No VIP crawlers nearby, and I'd avoid the locals. The next interview is likely the fourth night. I have had to take on extra people for the requests.

beats.headline: The producer is not talking
beats.text: Carl, I'm watching. The whole universe is watching, and we are all rooting for you. I can't interfere, and I told him so. He explained what he wants anyway. I said it was impossible; he said try. So: I messaged the producer, and he didn't want to speak with me. I think he is waiting to see how this plays out. My boss made me run the request past the Syndicate AI referee, and it will only allow this under very strict circumstances. Nobody can give Carl any help whatsoever.

beats.headline: She signs on Carl's behalf
beats.text: Okay, so. Carl wants a message relayed to the producers of Vengeance of the Daughter, word for word, and this is not what we discussed. My boss patches them in and they hear all of it. They say, and I am quoting, "Let's see what you got for us, Crawler." It is a deal. Carl wants it official, on paper. I tell him it is official, because I have the power to sign on his behalf, and he says that is terrifying. I ask him if he knows what he is doing. He says no.

beats.headline: Who makes Vengeance of the Daughter
beats.text: Okay, so, Carl and Princess Donut are booked for the day after tomorrow on a round-table show called Danger Zone. Other crawlers, a few intergalactic celebrities, maybe a politician, and an uncensored call-in segment, so be ready for anything. Then Carl asks who is behind Vengeance of the Daughter. Not a Kua-Tin company: nobody in our system may run serials while we run the game. It is Sensation Entertainment, Incorporated, from one of the center systems, and the gentleman I dealt with was a Sac. Carl asks what a Sac is. Since he does not know, I cannot tell him.

beats.headline: Booking schedules are public
beats.text: Okay, so. That was terrifying, and I thought Carl and Princess Donut were dead for certain. How did they know which trailer? Rental trailers put their booking schedules out for anybody to see, so everyone can coordinate availability. Nobody has ever needed to hide one, because nobody has ever tried to assassinate a crawler outside the dungeon. Now the Valtay have blown the royal yacht into dust. The good news is that nobody on the net is saying anything negative about Carl and Princess Donut; the prince is the villain. Our team is fielding a wave of interview requests. Odette has the contract on the next one.

beats.headline: Katia needs to be more interesting
beats.text: Carl, Princess Donut, okay, so. I'm still working on your mid-floor appearance, and a lot depends on the sponsorship bidding. I need to bring something up while I can. It's about Katia. People don't like her. Odette complained about her participation in the interview, and the tunnel is full of people hoping she goes so it can be just the two of you again. You either need to ditch her or make her more interesting. A mohawk, maybe. I'm not allowed to message her directly yet. If they don't like her, they stop watching, and fewer views means fewer prizes.

beats.headline: Planet Beautiful
beats.text: Hi guys! The fans liked your line at the end, Carl. People want the trademark line more often, though not too much, or it gets weird. Okay, so, I booked you two for a show in two days. Katia stays in the dungeon; Mongo goes in the cage. It's called Planet Beautiful: narration from a sound booth, a segment about this season's planet. Carl asks what the segment is and tells me I'm a terrible liar. Okay. It's about beauty pageants. And pet shows. Princess Donut says yes before he can.

beats.headline: In case something happens to me
beats.text: Okay, so. I am still in the suit, because the dual-layer system was supposed to be replaced at the end of the third floor and Hinter would not rent us the cores. Congratulations, Katia, on the top ten. Odette has added a Katia option to her contract, with a rider: be zippier. In case something happens to me, I want you to know I appreciate how hard you have worked. Loita is Bloom, she has lost her main account, and she is claiming yours. I am not Bloom. Something happened at home. I cannot talk about it. Also, your chats go public tomorrow, for people who pay extra.

beats.headline: Just your social media manager
beats.text: Hey guys! Wow, that was fantastic. Great job. Your social numbers are looking great! Okay, so, Princess Donut, I am just your social media manager now. Administrator Loita is in charge of all public appearances, and you are not able to message me directly unless I open the chat. I've never been better, thank you. Carl, the audience is noting that you are being extra angry with the other crawlers. Katia, your numbers are rising steadily. Princess Donut, people want more Mongo, and you have used your new spells only once. Now get back out there and kill, kill, kill!

beats.headline: If you must choose, Ivy
beats.text: Okay, so, the audience loves the strange vibe of the doll, but I tend to agree with the crawler: it does not sound like Princess Donut. We put that in the notes. Veriluxx hasn't changed it. Carl says he can't imagine it doing well, presented the way it is, and I tell him he is not wrong. There are memes. When Princess Donut asks whether she should name her robot Charlie or Ivy, I tell her it is inconsequential, crawler. Then, before the chat closes: if you must choose a name, I would go with Ivy.

beats.headline: Goodbye, from behind the scenes
beats.text: Anyway, the fans really enjoyed that battle. Good job, you two. I'm sorry to say this is goodbye, however. I will still be Loita's assistant, working behind the scenes, but you no longer need a social media manager. Loita explains it: they have bought the social media board, so nobody needs to relay what the dry masses are saying about them. Carl asks whether I can come down so Princess Donut can say goodbye. Loita says no, of course not. He asks whether I can come to the infomercial. Loita says it is not my job anymore.

beats.headline: A message from the politburo
beats.text: Hello, Carl and Princess Donut. Okay, so, there was another last-minute legal challenge to what you are about to attempt, and it failed; the Valtay sent an attorney to help Borant. I have also been asked to pass on a message. It is from the politburo, who have recently replaced the board of directors in control of Borant, and it is a direct quote: they approve of what you are planning, and game-breaking antics that directly affect sponsors will not be tolerated in the future. Carl, you know such language is not acceptable. Best of luck to you.

beats.headline: They are enraged
beats.text: Oh my god, Carl. They are enraged. This is not what you promised. If you fill Larracos with water and mobs, it kills the NPCs. The markets flood, the mercenaries die, and if the NPCs at the entrance bar die, the sponsors lose access to the Desperado Club. We cannot add new worker NPCs once a level is created. That is written into the rules. Fixing it would need a Syndicate vote they will not have, and the AI on board. You have killed thousands. Tens of thousands. There will be consequences.

beats.headline: She reminds him the contract stands
beats.text: Carl. I know you have a lot going on. I know the Hunting Grounds are the Hunting Grounds. I still have to say this, because saying it is my job: your agreement with the Vengeance of the Daughter programme is still in effect. Nothing you signed on an earlier floor stops mattering because you have gone down a set of stairs. It doesn't work like that. Please don't make me be the one who has to remind you twice.

beats.headline: Bad timing, on purpose
beats.text: Hey guys! I just wanted to quickly touch base. We rearranged the schedule a little, so you'll be visiting with Odette today. Try not to schedule a boss battle or anything during that time. Yes, everything is okay, and yes, I will be there. Carl, I also want to remind you that you'll be receiving some extra scrutiny before you go to the trailer. So just be aware. But you'll be fine, because you're both really strong and brave. Especially you, Donut.

beats.headline: The ratings are okay
beats.text: Okay, so, Princess Donut asks how the ratings are on Signet's show, and I say they're okay. Ratings were good on the third floor when Carl and Princess Donut were involved, and they lagged a little while they were on the fourth and fifth. People really like the six warriors and their caterpillar mount. Some of the hardcore fans think Carl and Princess Donut are going to make everything implode before there's a resolution, or take the show over. I am talking to the Sensation people so they're back in a saferoom in time for Odette's show.

beats.headline: Close that yap
beats.text: Okay, so, Odette dropped this on me as we started preparing, and I'm the one who tells Carl the part she didn't: she's using Bea to blackmail Borant. I also have to tell him about the fan box. The votes are in, and soon after he opens it he goes to an event with fans, alone, without Princess Donut. That's where they were going to confront him. When he asks why I'm so nervous, I whisper that Donut is going to need him, to focus on that, and that he needs to close that yap of his right now. Please.

beats.headline: Linger as much as you can
beats.text: Okay, so, this is not a regular production trailer. It's a Valtay landing vessel parked at the bottom of the ocean, and we are under constant surveillance, by the AI and by the ship's own security. The rental trailers were kicked off system after an escape attempt. Donut had quite the fight, and she's okay, safe in the guildhall. I can't tell him more. I tell Carl it might be in his best interests to linger as much as he can, that others may be waiting where he goes back down, and that he needs his rest.

beats.headline: Because of a pin
beats.text: Okay, so, the moderator is Circe Took, a minor hive queen, and the hunter Carl killed was her daughter, Xindy, Vrah's little sister, on her first hunt. Try to avoid talking about her government. He asks if I'm doing okay. About the best anyone can expect. Our whole system has gone dark. Those of us who stayed on after the change don't know if we'll be welcomed home or executed as traitors. My entire family was slaughtered because I refused to wear a pin. But I've got a job to do. I have to go, Carl.

beats.headline: The interview tunneled
beats.text: Okay, so. Carl, you need to get to a saferoom. You're getting filthy, and you have your event. I also need you to know that Odette's interview with you and Princess Donut and Beatrice tunneled last night, and between that and the Dark Hive business there is a lot of attention focused on you. I'll see what I can do about your attorney. There is something else we need to discuss, but I will do it in person.

beats.headline: Promoted, and still in the dark
beats.text: Skindle, who looks after Dmitri and Maxim, introduces me as her boss. I did get a promotion. Carl, about your replacement sponsor: the first winner of the bidding could not pay, so there was a new bidding event, and the winner wants to award your first benefactor box during the signing. You will see who at the end. Who could not pay is still above my pay grade. About three hundred fans won a lottery place, plus thirty premiums, plus press.

beats.headline: Warrants, and who buys them
beats.text: Carl, we can't bring you anywhere. Nihit has been healed and wants to press charges for assault. It was off system, so the regular rules apply, and you are not a full citizen. If they prosecute, the charges are shelved until you're out, and then you get a warrant with a sentence, usually two or three cycles. Licensed corporations can buy out warrants when they need workers. It is not true slavery. They get paid when they get out. They're criminals.

beats.headline: The council closes the courts
beats.text: Okay, so. After the brambles hit Zockau there were several lawsuits, and they failed immediately. Then the Syndicate Council itself, not the subcommittee, the actual council, ruled that nobody may file a suit naming the AI as a defendant. It is meant to slow the deterioration. That has started a whole new set of suits about whether the council can do that. Mordecai is right that the money is flowing to Borant. Our Valtay partners have shown no dismay so far. The council and the liaisons are very nervous. Now stop talking about this.

beats.headline: Drop this, Carl
beats.text: Carl. I highly suggest you drop this. I say it once, while he is telling Signet that the people controlling her world will not let her win, and he does not drop it. I say it again when he starts offering her a new plan: they are not going to let it happen this way, and we have discussed this.

beats.headline: Do not bring Signet to the party
beats.text: Carl, I need to be very clear about this, so I am going to be. Do not attempt to smuggle Signet into the party. If you try, the production company is contractually forced to send her directions to do something premature, and it will get her killed and very likely you with her. If she is in that room, the courts have to decide who owns what happens next. It is a hard rule: nobody touches the main event. He tells me he has no such plans.

beats.headline: It's complicated, Carl
beats.text: Florin has told Carl there are children in Lucia Mar's head, a Dutch girl of ten among them, and Carl wants to know why, when we said no child crawlers were allowed. Okay, so. It is complicated, Carl. You do not have to be involved in everything. We are not going to discuss it, and especially not now. Heads up.

beats.headline: The Popovs are ineligible
beats.text: Carl has dug two naked baby ogres out of the gore, Maxim and Dmitri, and wants to know what to do with them. You don't need to do anything, Carl. Watch. Ineligible. Relax: children and pregnant crawlers aren't allowed. Their game guide made them pick that race because he knew this would happen. They've been transferred to the kinder facility on the surface. They're free. And while I have you: you're going on Odette's show right after the next floor starts.

beats.headline: Odette takes some days off
beats.text: Okay, so, some news. Carl and Princess Donut, you were scheduled on Odette's show tonight, but she has decided to take several days off. She's fine. She usually moves to the system's orbit for the ninth floor, and Prepotente's little stunt accelerated everyone's schedule, so she is traveling. I turned down Plenty of Plenty on your behalf. There is also a preproduction meeting for the ninth floor, with reps from all nine teams, and I took the liberty of assuming you will want to be there. Your presence will be virtual. And yes, Princess Donut, it will be catered.

beats.headline: Doing the work of five
beats.text: Harbinger stops the interview on his own say-so, recalls Carl's attorney, and bans Rosetta. I tell him he does not have the authority to do that, that we are going to have to refund them, and that they are going to sue and win. He says no such lawsuits are proceeding. Then Carl asks whether I deliberately didn't tell his attorney Harbinger would be there. No, Carl. We lost dozens of staff in the Valtay changeover, we were not prepared for this eighth floor, the Valtay will not allow some of the micro AI systems I used to have, and I am doing the work of five. I will make a note of it.

beats.headline: Advice, off the record
beats.text: I turn on extra security, so this is an administrator speaking to show sponsors. Odette is going to ask to be their adjutant, and I think it's a bad idea. An adjutant is a neutral observer, part referee, usually someone loud and famous doing colour commentary, and Odette has done it a few times. But Odette was Mordecai's manager once, and if they are physically together he will attack her. He gets kicked out. His contract is in jeopardy. Half the children he is fostering get ejected. None of this is official. I like Mordecai. Please do not pick her.

beats.headline: Straight from the show to phase two
beats.text: Okay, so. Carl, Princess Donut, I need you both back in four and a half hours. You are going on Odette's show, and you are going to walk straight from there into the Phase Two onboarding chamber. Just so you know, Harbinger will be there again, observing virtually. He is insisting on it. And yes, we have alerted your attorney, who will also be present.

beats.headline: Four choices, and a mountain
beats.text: Okay, so. Carl and Princess Donut, I apologise for that glitch, and I know it is going to look intentional. It was not. At least not on our end. You should have had three choices: one of ours, one of the AI's, one random. You had four. Some crawlers had one, a few had none, and one squad leader had the whole globe and dropped herself into the middle of the ocean. And yes, the key location was taken out of Iowa and set down on your island. It was the only way to do it without breaking anything further. We're very busy.

beats.headline: Everything until the timer
beats.text: Carl asks me whether this is even real, how long it took us to find, whether we just recorded everything. I'm sorry, Carl. You know I can't give you details. But I assure you, everything you have seen so far is indeed a recording of what really happened that day. Everything until the timer reaches zero. I can't tell you more than that.

beats.headline: Your sponsor has disappeared
beats.text: Okay, so. I probably should not be telling you this, Carl. Your sponsor sent that box days ago, before you even picked Miami. It was seized. And then the whole charity, and everyone involved, simply disappeared. Rosetta too. Nobody knows where. I do not know what you are riding into, and I do not think the AI does either. The failsafe? I do not know what it does. They will not use it. Not with so many people trapped here.

beats.headline: A short quest, and nobody knows
beats.text: I told your teammates you are on a short quest nobody understands, which is true, and that there are no mobs near you, which also appears to be true. The AI insists that we not interfere with you or the feed. When we argued about that, it leaked our internal debates onto the main feed. Members of the Syndicate council, the real council, are here on planet and locked out. What is a Residual? I am forbidden to tell you. I think you are about to find out.

beats.headline: They paid the license fee
beats.text: Princess Donut writes to me in capitals that Louis's shirt is an outrage. It is a Donut Holes shirt, and the Donut Holes paid the license fee, so it is a perfectly legitimate brand and her merch is doing quite well. She asks whether she gets any of the money. Okay, so: no. If she reaches the tenth floor she gets a stipend and can negotiate a small percentage based on her licensing fee, and past a threshold she gets a percentage automatically. I don't know the threshold. I don't think anybody has ever gotten close.

beats.headline: An order from the prime minister
beats.text: Okay, so. I know I've been quiet, but we are monitoring. This comes directly from the Syndicate council: Prime Minister Glory himself messaged me. Carl is not to talk to Agatha. I do not know why. The residuals are harmless every season, and the AI supposedly removed its protections from them, and they are pretty much all dead, except this one. It seems to have a soft spot for her. Lucia Mar does not respond to messages anymore. And Carl, the roundtable is part of the game. It is not optional.

beats.headline: The council goes ahead
beats.text: Okay, so. We are doing this warlord council whether we like it or not. The Syndicate council tried to cancel it, but the AI is insisting everything go on like normal, broadcast in real time. The warlords all go to the production facility, in different randomized rooms, so nobody can hurt anybody. All except Juice Box: there are protections disallowing the dungeon born, so she appears virtually from the castle. Ferdinand will likely be in the same room as Carl. Like the same same room. There is a security check, so please do not smuggle anything in.

beats.headline: The Aryl system went dark
beats.text: Okay, so, this is only a few hours old. When Princess Formidable did not come back, a few orcs went into the Venus station and triggered the failsafe themselves. Nothing happened here. But the moment they pressed the button, the Aryl system went dark. Aryl was the last crawl, a Squim battle royale season, and its tunnel node is offline. That has never happened in history. The closest neighbour is 2.9 light cycles away. Its AI had been working but silent since around the sixth floor of this season. It is terrifying.

beats.headline: I should not be telling you
beats.text: Okay, so. The liaisons want to interview Lucia now the dog is dead, for at least an hour. We assumed her getting in was a glitch, and we wanted to kick her back out. Now the AI says it cannot extract her. It is not all the children, Carl. Just the ones who tried to get into the dungeon, and only the ones in one wing, on the surface in the kinder facility. We think if she goes, they all go. I should not be telling you any of this. About a hundred and twenty thousand.

beats.headline: We are not complying
beats.text: Carl, that ejection request did not come from us. Okay, so. Several warships in orbit have started firing on several other ships, and not pot shots: full missile barrages and maser blasts. We just got a notice from the Syndicate Council telling us to initiate headquarters self-destruct, and then a message from the Valtay showrunners telling us not to comply. Obviously we are not complying. I don't know yet whether the mercs will be on our side or the Syndicate's. Say what you were going to say. Quick.

beats.headline: The tenth floor, announced
beats.text: Okay, so. Just over five thousand five hundred crawlers survived Faction Wars and chose to go on, which means almost fifteen thousand took a deal, which is fantastic, and a record. The system AI has asked me to tell you to ignore the other floors and carry on as if everything is normal, and I have read out its exact wording, twice, so that it is accurate. The floor is called Don't Come in Last. Seven heats, nine teams each, one thousand eight hundred teams, and the AI has designed most of the tracks. Please try not to kill more than one team, because if more than two teams don't make it to the finish line—

beats.headline: One ticket not cancelled
beats.text: Okay, so, Princess Donut, no, you do not get a meet-and-greet. It was set up a while ago in case anybody made it this far, and it sold out immediately: viewers in the stands for the end of each race, and a reception afterwards. Then everything happened. The quarantine is still in place. You can come to the Earth system, no problem, but once you are here, you cannot leave. All five hundred fans cancelled except one. A soother. A superfan of Elle's. Nobody would fly him in, so he bought his own yacht.

beats.headline: Reading the AI's script
beats.text: Okay, so. Every surviving crawler team has to do at least one show between races, and Carl and Princess Donut are on Plenty of Plenty in a few hours. Cascadia is not feeling well, so I am doing the announcement, and the AI is making me read a script. It changes the text while I am reading it. It plays a trumpet at me. I read it exactly as written. Then it puts Cascadia on the loudspeaker. I am okay. I tell Princess Donut I am okay.

beats.headline: The survival containment
beats.text: Hello, racers. Okay, so, this race has survival containment, and there is a rule change, so please listen carefully. The bubble keeps out the air on your next heat, which will kill you. It is indestructible. You lose it only if your vehicle or mount is destroyed, and then, if you survive and cross the line ahead of another team, you can still survive. How that might happen, I don't know. Winners get a key to a defeated team's garage. Other heats share the track. Good luck.

beats.headline: The twist at the pit stop
beats.text: Hi again, everybody. Most of you have made it to your pit stops, so it's time for the twist. Each track has four heats, and each pit stop combines four tracks. Every heat rolls for where it goes next, so your second half may not be on the track you started on. If you were given a quest you have not finished, please do not worry. Quests are mirrored across the tracks and yours will be transferred. You will be able to finish it. Good luck, everybody.

beats.headline: On lockdown at headquarters
beats.text: Sorry, Princess Donut. I'm fine. Okay, so, things are a little chaotic here at headquarters. Cascadia accidentally took too much of her medicine, and I am putting accidentally in quotation marks, and when the AI intervened a goddess nobody has heard of appeared inside the submerged wings and caused an uproar. I'm on lockdown until it's sorted. One of the satellite headquarters on the surface is temporarily running everything.

beats.headline: Every show Princess Donut has mentioned
beats.text: Okay, so. Gilmore Girls and Gossip Girl are taking the net by storm, and Odette's husband, of all people, was the first to buy the rights to every show Princess Donut has ever mentioned. It may be the only thing keeping the orcs solvent. I am terrified, but I am okay. I also have a question from Orren, who is blocked from sending messages for some reason: has Carl made his choices yet? Carl says he can wait to make them, so he is waiting. Okay. Thank you, Carl.
